TABLE.NAME: qtype_codelab_options
TABLE.COMMENT: Language, code and tests of CodeLab questions.

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key linking to the question table.

FIELD.NAME: language
FIELD.COMMENT: Programming language: c, cpp, python, java or csharp.

FIELD.NAME: prefix
FIELD.COMMENT: Code added before the student's code when it is run, not shown to students.

FIELD.NAME: suffix
FIELD.COMMENT: Code added after the student's code when it is run, not shown to students.

FIELD.NAME: tests
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of tests: stdin, expected, hidden, weight. No tests: graded manually.

FIELD.NAME: showtests
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 to let students run the tests that are not hidden during the attempt.

FIELD.NAME: comparison
FIELD.COMMENT: How the output is compared: exact, spaces (at the end of lines do not count), numbers or regex.

FIELD.NAME: tolerance
FIELD.COMMENT: Largest absolute or relative difference of two numbers for the comparison numbers.

FIELD.NAME: cputime
FIELD.COMMENT: CPU time limit in seconds; 0 for the setting of tiny_codelab.

FIELD.NAME: memorylimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Memory limit in MB; 0 for the default of Jobe.

FIELD.NAME: noassist
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 to turn off code completion and hints in the attempt.
